events.mission.text.terms:
● Dispela event em i bilong ol registered member bilong {value} tasol, em ol i gat valid account na i pinisim real-name verification.

● Daily mission bai reset olgeta de long 00:00 (GMT+8), na yu mas pinisim insait long dispela de yet.

● Weekly mission bai reset long olgeta Mande long 00:00 (GMT+8), na yu mas pinisim insait long dispela wik (Mande inap Sande).

● Monthly mission bai reset long de namba 1 bilong olgeta mun long 00:00 (GMT+8), na yu mas pinisim bipo 23:59 long las de bilong dispela mun.

● Long deposit count mission, olgeta deposit i mas inap long minimum amount requirement. Sapos i no inap long mak, bai i no kaun.

● Mission i mas bihainim ol tok i stap long mission page. Sapos i no pinis olgeta, bai i stap olsem mission i no complete.

● Taim mission i complete, reward bai system i verify pinis na salim automatically, o bai i go insait long member account insait long 24 hour.

● Sampela mission i wok tasol long ol makim game, game category, o game provider. Plis lukim mission page long detail.

● Ol cash reward i mas mekim 5x turnover pastaim na bihain inap askim withdrawal.

● Store coins em virtual currency bilong platform na i no inap senis i kamap cash.

● I tambu tru long yusim planti account bilong joinim dispela event. Sapos violation i kamap, qualification bai cancel na ol related account bai freeze.

● Sapos system i lukim abnormal betting, mission abuse, group operation, o narapela fraud behavior, {value} i gat rait long cancelim olgeta reward na suspendim account permanent.

● {value} i gat rait long senisim, suspendim, o pinisim dispela event na ol related rules long any taim wantaim no prior notice.

● Sapos i gat dispute long dispela event, {value} i gat final interpretation right.

● Sapos ol language version i no wankain, English version bai win.

withdrawal.tutorial.text.firstTimeNotice:
Fes taim wash scor? Plis luksave long ol dispela samting:

1. Long stopim skam, wasim moni, o stil account long rausim moni, yumi laik askim ol player long givim tru info bilong id bilong stret tru. Tasol info bilong stret tru inap yusim long topap na rausim moni. Sapos info bilong bank i no wankain olsem id info, transaksen bai mipela cancel.

2. Sapos moni bilong yu i no gat 1x turnover (bet amount = deposit amount), bai yu no inap askim long rausim moni.

3. Yu ken rausim moni 3 taim tasol long wanpela de. Sapos yu pinis 3 taim, yu mas wet inap long nekis de.

4. Last deposit em bai makim wanem kain moni yu ken rausim. Yu no inap yusim narapela kain moni long rausim — tasol dispela no inap long MYR.

Plis bihainim ol rul. Sapos yu no bihainim, mipela i no inap holim resposibiliti long loss o problem.
